_about: Hand-curated point-of-sale sewer dye-test / lateral certification rules for Allegheny County municipalities, compiled from primary municipal pages and codes on 2026-10-29. No consolidated county list exists. Every entry must be re-verified with the municipality before relying on it; fees and lead times change.
_match_note: Keys are matched case-insensitively against the assessor MUNIDESC after stripping ward text; City of Pittsburgh wards all map to 'pittsburgh'.

pittsburgh.name: City of Pittsburgh (PWSA)
pittsburgh.applies: Properties in a separate sanitary-sewer area need the dye test; combined-sewer areas are exempt from the test but still need the Evidence of Compliance Certificate.
pittsburgh.lead_time: PWSA responds within 10 business days at each step
pittsburgh.source_note: PWSA Dye Testing Ordinance page (2006 ordinance)

mt. lebanon.name: Mt. Lebanon
mt. lebanon.performed_by: Allegheny County-licensed plumber (municipality does not schedule tests)
mt. lebanon.lead_time: Evidence of Compliance at least 10 business days before closing; interim relief request at least 14
mt. lebanon.fail_handling: Inclement-weather and defects escrow agreements available

upper st. clair.name: Upper St. Clair
upper st. clair.applies: Sale; plus separate sewer lateral video inspection (effective 2018-01-01)
upper st. clair.performed_by: Registered plumber; NASSCO-certified technician for the lateral video
upper st. clair.lead_time: Forms at least 14 days before closing

fox chapel.name: Fox Chapel
fox chapel.applies: Sale (sanitary sewer certification; condition of the no-lien letter)
fox chapel.performed_by: ACHD-licensed plumber registered with the Borough; Borough staff oversee
fox chapel.fee: $425 application; $1,000 inclement-weather deposit; $150 minimum return visit
fox chapel.lead_time: Web page says 30 days before closing (ordinance text says 7 days) — confirm with Borough
fox chapel.fail_handling: Defects Agreement with escrow; Inclement Weather Agreement

dormont.name: Dormont
dormont.performed_by: ACHD-licensed plumber; dye test plus video camera inspection
dormont.fee: Set by Council resolution (not stated online)
dormont.lead_time: Apply before sale; weather deferral 14 days
dormont.fail_handling: $200 weather security; plumber contract plus cash security for defects

scott.name: Scott Township
scott.applies: Sale, transfer, mortgage, refinance; apartments/condos exempt

bethel park.name: Bethel Park
bethel park.applies: Deed transfer: dye test plus camera lateral inspection
bethel park.fail_handling: Repairs required before deed transfer; municipal sign-off

baldwin.name: Baldwin Borough
baldwin.fail_handling: $200 weather / cash security; temporary certificate 30 days
baldwin.source_note: Borough Code Chapter 134 Article VIII §§134-32 to 134-37
